explanation: In December 1971 a fan fired a flare gun during a Frank Zappa show, and the casino where the band had planned to record burned down. Nobody was killed.

claims.text: 'Smoke on the Water' describes the fire at the Montreux Casino, in Switzerland, during a Frank Zappa concert.
The fire described in 'Smoke on the Water' did not happen in Geneva, Zurich or Lucerne.
The Montreux Casino fire happened on 4 December 1971.
The fire started when a member of the audience fired a flare gun.
Deep Purple had gone to Montreux to make an album at the casino.
Nobody died in the Montreux Casino fire.
